disposition_reason: Cr(III)/Cr(VI) speciation in 22 retail breads and breakfast cereals (France, Denmark). The only cocoa-related items are two cocoa breakfast cereals (20.1% cocoa: total Cr 360 ± 51, Cr(III) 350 ± 6 µg/kg; 16.5% cocoa: 219 ± 7 and 238 ± 1 µg/kg; Cr(VI) < 0.047 µg/kg), which are composite cereal foods, not cocoa materials.
disposition_locator: Table 2 (sample list) p.3; Table 7 p.6; Discussion p.6

study.design: analytical method study with retail samples
study.material_scope: breads and breakfast cereals (no cocoa/chocolate material)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: purchased in supermarkets in Maisons-Alfort (France) and Birkerød (Denmark)
study.method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; Cr species by species-specific isotope dilution HPLC-ICP-MS
study.qa: NIST 8436 durum wheat flour CRM; accuracy profile

notes: Cocoa cereals are the highest Cr products in the set (authors cite Roussel 2007: 316 µg/kg in cereals with cacao), context for cocoa as a Cr carrier but not a cocoa occurrence row. Cr(III) 238 > total Cr 219 in the 16.5% cereal (109% recovery) is within method uncertainty.
